title: Rust 1.99 deprecates AtomicUsize::fetch_update (renamed try_update): cargo check on master now warns in three places
outcome: `cargo check --bin termal` and `cargo test --bin termal` build without warnings on Rust 1.99.0 (installed by Greg's rustup update on 2026-10-01 at about 21:49Z). Gate test-338cbb53 (Termal::Opus3, w-3bd74078208d) shows the deprecation warning "use of deprecated method std::sync::atomic::Atomic::<usize>::fetch_update: renamed to try_update for consistency" at src/content_revision.rs:293, src/engram_source_roots.rs:978 and src/tests/engram_abort_retry.rs:44. All three are master code, not that change. CLAUDE.md requires cargo check clean. Mechanical fix: rename fetch_update to try_update with identical semantics. Watch for other 1.99 warnings in the same build. TermAl has no rust-toolchain pin, and the gate runs no clippy.
acceptance: The full five-stage gate passes on the exact reviewed tree, its run directory and fingerprint cited in a note.
cargo check --bin termal and the test build produce no warnings on rustc 1.99.0; the cargo-check log of the gate cited in a note shows none.

completion.summary: The rustc 1.99 fetch_update deprecations are renamed to try_update; landed in train 11 as 2a3506a, pushed.
